room_rent.note: SI ₹7.5L, ₹10L, ₹15L: Single Private Room. SI ₹25L and above: up to SI (no cap).

icu.note: ICU charges covered up to Sum Insured for all SI options.

copayment.display: 20% (age 61+ at first entry); 15% zone co-pay if Zone 2 treats in Zone 1
copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay applies to all insured persons aged 61+ at first policy issuance, on all subsequent renewals too. Zone 2 policyholders bear 15% co-pay for treatment in Zone 1. Co-pay waiver available as optional add-on.

sub_limits.display: Maternity sub-limits; Bariatric sub-limits; Emergency evacuation sub-limits
sub_limits.note: Maternity: Normal ₹40K–₹1.35L / C-Section ₹60K–₹1.35L depending on SI. Bariatric: ₹3.75L–₹10L depending on SI. Emergency Medical Evacuation: ₹2.5L–₹5L (not available for ₹7.5L–₹15L). OPD: ₹5K–₹10K. Home Healthcare: 25% of SI max ₹10L. Most other covers up to SI.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Optional voluntary deductible available: ₹10K/₹25K/₹50K for lower SIs, up to ₹5L for higher SIs.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months. Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months: cataracts, hernia, BPH, DNS, hydrocele, fistula/haemorrhoids, fibromyoma, tumours/cysts, LASIK, stones, varicose veins, gastric ulcers, ear/tonsil surgery, etc. 36 months: rheumatoid arthritis, gout, joint replacement (degenerative), osteoarthritis/osteoporosis.

maternity.display: Covered (36mo wait); Normal ₹40K–₹1.35L, C-Section ₹60K–₹1.35L by SI
maternity.note: Not available for ₹7.5L and ₹10L SI. Available from ₹15L SI upwards. Both self and spouse must be covered for 36 continuous months. Max 2 events lifetime. Ectopic pregnancy covered under inpatient.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of SI added per claim-free year; reduced by 50% in claim year (minimum zero); max accumulation 100% of SI.

restoration.note: Triggers from 2nd claim onwards after full exhaustion of Base SI + CB + Inflation Guard. Applicable for same or different illness. Once per claim event. Not applicable for Medical Treatment Abroad.

post_hosp.note: SI ₹7.5L, ₹10L, ₹15L: 90 days. SI ₹25L and above: 180 days.

day_care.display: All day-care procedures covered up to SI

domiciliary.display: Covered (Home Health Care up to 25% of SI, max ₹10L)
domiciliary.note: Cashless only via empanelled provider. Conditions apply. Only allopathic treatment.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered. Must be in government hospital or recognised AYUSH hospital. Minimum 24-hour admission required.

ambulance.note: Emergency road ambulance covered up to Sum Insured per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: Covers robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, stem cell therapy (haematopoietic), and others listed.

consumables.note: Consumables/Non-Medical Expenses Cover available as optional add-on for all SI options.

global_cover.display: Inbuilt (8 major illnesses; 36mo wait; up to SI)
global_cover.note: Medical Treatment Abroad inbuilt for 8 specific conditions (craniotomy, lung/liver lobectomy, major organ transplant, bone marrow transplant, aortic aneurysm repair, heart valve replacement, CABG). Available from ₹50L and ₹100L and ₹200L SI per schedule. 36 months continuous coverage required. Inflation Guard and Unlimited Restoration not applicable for this benefit.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim contestable except on grounds of fraud.

notable_exclusions: External congenital anomaly, STDs (non-HIV), stem cell storage, hormone replacement therapy, treatment outside India (except 8 listed conditions), LASIK (24mo wait), infertility/ART
optional_riders: Voluntary Deductible, Consumables/Non-Medical Expenses Cover, Mandatory Co-Pay Waiver (for age 61+ entrants)
